svg.title: Previous category-specific paradigm and category-unified paradigm comparison
svg.desc: Two-row academic diagram. Top row: previous category-specific paradigm with four category icons, four separate model boxes, dense point-to-point template/search-region interaction, and global-pooled/point-wise localization with feature points, score boxes, arrows and a bounding-box point cloud. Bottom row: category-unified paradigm with category icons feeding one unified model, adaptive keypoint sparse alignment, and structure-aware localization with keypoint graph and bounding box. SAM picture assets map category icons only; all diagrams, text, frames, arrows and point-cloud details are constructed in native SVG and then confirmed icon assets are overlaid at their original source crop positions.

g.desc: Inventory: pedestrian, truck, car, ellipsis, cyclist icons vertically aligned at left; each category points right to its own rounded beige model box. Caption states one category one model. The visual basis is vertical equipartition of categories and model boxes inside a single rounded frame.

Inventory: labels Template and Search Region on the left of two stacked point-cloud boxes; red dense lines connect many template points into a common search-region location. Basis: two equal-width aligned image frames stacked vertically.

Inventory: bold italic global-pooled localization title, green pooling bracket arrow to red feature dots, three blue horizontal point-wise lines into red index boxes, purple score-selection text and line, and right bounding-box cloud with a red rectangle. Basis: horizontal left-to-right pipeline with a central feature-list symmetry.
Inventory: four object categories vertically aligned at left, one horizontal arrow to a single beige rounded category-unified model. Basis: unified many-to-one layout centered in the rounded frame.

Inventory: labels Template and Search Region flank two point-cloud boxes. Sparse keypoints are diamond nodes with vertical red matching lines between corresponding points. Basis: paired top-bottom frames sharing x coordinates for alignment.

Inventory: colored geometric structure at left uses yellow top keypoints, green bottom keypoints, dashed red vertical correspondence edges, orange upper bars, thick green lower bars, and a blue arrow to the right bounding-box panel. Inside the panel a red bounding box encloses blue point cloud and a green structure. Basis: left-to-right graph-to-bounding-box pipeline.

Mappings: top pedestrian original object - draft_icon_top_pedestrian - asset_sam_region_000027; top truck - draft_icon_top_truck - asset_sam_region_000025; top car - draft_icon_top_car - asset_sam_region_000022; top cyclist - draft_icon_top_bike - asset_sam_region_000026; bottom pedestrian - draft_icon_bottom_pedestrian - asset_sam_region_000028; bottom truck - draft_icon_bottom_truck - asset_sam_region_000023; bottom car - draft_icon_bottom_car - asset_sam_region_000021; bottom cyclist - draft_icon_bottom_bike - asset_sam_region_000024. Replacements cover icons only; frames, arrows, labels and model boxes are retained.
